duel.heading: Head to head · PokéConnections
duel.blurb4: The same sixteen Pokémon for both of you. The first to find all four groups wins.
duel.blurb5: The same twenty-five Pokémon for both of you. The first to find all five groups wins.
duel.rules: Each mistake adds {seconds} seconds to your time, and {mistakes} mistakes put you out. If you're both out, more groups found wins. You see your opponent's groups as colours as they find them, never which Pokémon.
duel.fresh: Send a friend the link, or find an opponent (4×4 only). Duels use fresh puzzles, never the daily, and never count toward your streak.
duel.size4: Sixteen Pokémon, four groups of four
duel.size5: Twenty-five Pokémon, five groups of five
